title: mcp: the record data tools and the record resource drop declaredCode, where /data serves an unregistered code's spelling there (VENDOR_DOWN / 503)
body:
domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5p3T5YWhLjurajudnQ

## What is wrong

A producer throws an app's own, unregistered code with a declared status, for example `{ code: 'VENDOR_DOWN', status: 503 }`.

- `/api/v1/data` (`mapDataError`) answers the status's closed code, `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503. It keeps the producer's spelling in `declaredCode: 'VENDOR_DOWN'`.
- Since #31341 (PR #31371), the MCP record data tools (`query_records`, `aggregate_records`, `get_record`, `create_record`, `update_record`, `delete_record`, `delete_records`' selection read) and the `objectstack://objects/{name}/records/{id}` resource answer the same closed code, but serve no `declaredCode`. Before #31341 they answered `code: 'VENDOR_DOWN'`. So the agent now gets less than the REST door gives.

MCP `run_action` / `resume_run` already serve `declaredCode` (and `userMessage`) as `/actions` does (#31271), so the record faces are the odd ones out.

## Expected

The record data faces serve `declaredCode` (and `userMessage`, if the door serves it) whenever the `/data` door serves it, read from the same answer (`dataDoorAnswerOf` / `mapDataError`), never a copy. The same check applies to a code-less 4xx whose code the door demotes.

## Where to start

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`: `dataDoorAnswerOf` / `DataDoorAnswer` (today `{ code?, message, status }`), `dataDoorErrorResult`, and the record resource catch in `mcp-server-runtime.ts`.
- PR #31371 pins the `VENDOR_DOWN` / 503 row as a stated consequence; that row moves with this card.

## Provenance

Stated consequence 2 in the #31341 dev's hand-back (report 6717377210 on #31341, PR #31371). Filed by the seat as its carrier.
